Subject: Leadership heatcheck: Q2 customer trajectories + renewal redlines

Team,

As we head into the Q2 QBR window I pulled a small slice of accounts where renewal posture has shifted over the last 30–60 days. I want a short, clear signal for the exec readout on Monday: which customers need proactive outreach / SLA concessions / commercial interventions.

Quick asks (please reply inline):
- One-line trajectory per account (Green / Watch / At-risk)
- Primary cause (ops / pricing / product / procurement)
- Recommended exec action (e.g., DRI + ask to Legal/Finance + credit authority)

Attached: renewal_redlines_v1.xlsx — contains the accounts, MRR, renewal month, and our current recommended ask.

Initial accounts I care about for the exec slate: Acme Cloud (renewing May), Borealis (June), Meridian (July). I flagged Acme as Watch because of their latency regressions and procurement noise. See notes in the attachment.

I"m copying Aditya (sales ops) and Rishi (customer success lead) — please add your quick notes by EOD Friday. Laura, will you own the exec ask framing?

Thanks,

Chloe Martin
Director, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership heatcheck: Q2 customer trajectories + renewal redlines

Chloe — thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes inline on Acme and Meridian: 

Acme Cloud — Watch
- MRR: $48k; renewal May
- Primary cause: Ops (latency + recent error spike) and procurement delay. Procurement has pushed for additional contract terms; contracts@acme.com asked for a two-week extension to review SLA language.
- Recommended exec action: escalation to Head of Sales + offer a one-time service credit (TBD) if ops stabilization plan delivered in 30 days.

Meridian — Green->Watch (previously green)
- Small uptick in usage but asked about alternative quantized model to reduce cost. Pricing conversation in SVP queue.
- Suggested: put a pricing engineer on the account for a tailored quantization plan.

I added comments in the attached sheet (row highlights). I'm available for a quick sync Friday at 4pm PT to triage if helpful.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Sales, Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership heatcheck: Q2 customer trajectories + renewal redlines

Chloe / team — flagging an ops escalation that landed overnight from Acme. Forwarding the customer note so you have direct visibility.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Brian Cole <brian.cole@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 08:44:12 -0400
Subject: Spike in inference latency — urgent
To: support@redwood.com
Cc: acme-ops@acme.com

Hi Redwood team,

We observed a ~3x increase in tail latency for our surfacing endpoint on Friday evening (US-EAST). This impacts our checkout flow and we've already queued our engineering ops to revert a recent client-side change. We need confirmation from your side that there was no versioned rollout on Friday and an ETA on when this will be mitigated.

Please treat as P1 — Brian

---------- End forwarded message ---------

I pulled logs — short version: there was a degraded kernel selection path on one of the serving pools Friday 20:15–23:10 PT. Root cause: an autoscaling jitter + a kernel fallback that increased per-token latency for long-context requests. We've isolated the pool and applied a hotfix; full rollback plan scheduled for Monday morning.

Implications for renewal: severity of customer impact + procurement delay increases Acme risk to "At-risk" if they keep seeing interruptions. I'd recommend we treat Acme as "At-risk" for the exec slate unless we secure a commitment to a remediation timeline and a commercial make-good.

Attaching the ops extract: ACME_latency_issue_log.pdf

Rishi
VP, Customer Success
[Attachment: ACME_latency_issue_log.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

1) Acme Cloud — Move to "At-risk" unless we have a binding remediation milestone by EOD Monday. Exec ask: CTO + Head of Sales should join the customer call; Finance to be prepared to discuss a limited credit.
2) Meridian — Hold as Watch; assign Pricing Eng to run quick quantization pilot next week.
3) Borealis — Green but monitor usage; CS to note any spike in token growth.

Please add a single-line owner for each action in the sheet and I'll synthesize into a 1-slide exec readout. Chloe — can you confirm you own the Acme call intro and escalation to CTO? I can take the pricing framing for Meridian.

Laura Bennett
